hero.undertitel: Help the BibelBecca podcast grow – sponsor equipment that makes the content better

intro: BibelBecca is run entirely on a non-profit basis. If you'd like to help make the podcast possible, you can sponsor specific equipment – like microphones, cameras and lighting. Below you can see what's needed right now. Get in touch via the contact page and I'll tell you more!

behov.undertitel: Current sponsorship needs – big or small, everything makes a difference

tack.rubrik: As a thank you: pick a crocheted Bible item
tack.text: Everyone who sponsors gets to choose one of Becca's hand-crocheted Bible items as a thank you – a small greeting with a big heart. Write in your message which one you'd like!

saker.beskrivning: Hand-crocheted bookmark band for your Bible
Small crocheted lamb – the Lamb of God as a symbol
Crocheted donkey – like the one Jesus rode
Crocheted dove – symbol of peace and the Spirit

ovrigt.text: Not all support is money! You also help by subscribing to the channel, liking and sharing the videos, leaving a review on the podcast – and above all by praying for the work.

cta.rubrik: Would you like to sponsor something?
cta.text: Write to me via the contact form and tell me what you'd like to sponsor, and I'll get back to you with details.
